profile.statement: i build infrastructure in service of the experience on top of it.
profile.elaboration: the backend and the systems underneath are never the point. they're there to hold up something seamless for whoever is on the other end.
profile.closing: always down for a good chat.

notes: built workflows — a multi-step automation framework across every planview app, backend engine to agentic email client
designed the mcp integration registry behind hybrid tool calling
moved logging to an isolated cloudwatch pipeline to stay policy-compliant without losing observability
ran cpsc 110 labs for 600+ students, 90% favorable
